statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while scheduled U.S. macro and Nvidia catalysts keep Stress elevated.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The main checkpoints are the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster, the cash-open response, and Nvidia's after-hours results and conference call.
headline: Low Tail, elevated event Stress before U.S. data and Nvidia
body: Overnight reporting shows Nasdaq futures only slightly softer, while oil is down more than 2% and the U.S. 10-year yield is near 4.63%. No persistent one-way NQ structure is independently verified. Wednesday's macro cluster and Nvidia concentrate event risk without, by themselves, establishing a Tail path.

lookbackSummary: Published Tail remained low across all available preceding clock-hours. One historical slot was unavailable; the latest finalized hour was 15% Tail, 55% Stress and normal mode.
outlookSummary: Stress rises into the 12:30 UTC GDP/PCE/durable-goods cluster and U.S. cash open, then again around Nvidia's after-hours reporting window. Tail remains conditional on persistent one-way NQ structure, failed retracements and aligned cross-asset confirmation.

forecast.analysis: Late Asian trade remains a low-catalyst interval. Tail stays low unless NQ begins holding an extreme with shallow or failed retracements as Europe approaches.
The Asia-to-Europe handoff can test overnight direction. Mixed cross-asset behavior would cap Tail; repeated NQ extension after weak pullbacks would raise it.
European participation can confirm or reject the overnight move. Tail remains low unless directional efficiency persists across the handoff.
European cash trading may increase range and positioning sensitivity ahead of U.S. data. Aligned rates, semiconductors and failed NQ pullbacks would be the main escalation path.
Pre-U.S. positioning becomes more catalyst-sensitive. The approaching macro cluster raises Stress, while Tail still depends on observed persistence rather than the calendar alone.
Ranges may widen as GDP, PCE and durable-goods releases approach. No outcome is known; pre-release one-way structure would be the key Tail amplifier.
Final positioning before the 12:30 UTC releases keeps Stress high. Tail remains below WATCH unless shallow pullbacks and aligned cross-assets emerge before the data.
GDP, Personal Income and Outlays, and durable goods are scheduled for 12:30 UTC. WATCH reflects conditional post-release path risk, not an assumed surprise or reaction.
Post-data repricing overlaps the U.S. pre-open. Meaningful retracements and cross-asset stabilization would favor rapid Tail normalization; repeated extension would sustain WATCH.
The U.S. cash open can amplify any post-data move. Tail remains conditional on opening-auction continuation, failed retracements and NQ holding near an extreme.
Early cash-session price discovery should clarify whether the macro move is persistent or mean-reverting. Orderly two-way trade would lower Tail despite elevated Stress.
By late morning, sustained one-way structure would need fresh confirmation. If retracements broaden and rates stabilize, the conditional Tail path should continue to ease.
Midday liquidity can produce range expansion without persistent direction. Tail stays low unless a second directional leg develops with failed pullbacks.
Early afternoon remains between the macro impulse and Nvidia's after-hours catalyst. Stress stays elevated, while Tail requires current directional persistence.
Positioning may become more semiconductor-sensitive into the close. A broad, persistent NQ move with aligned megacaps would raise Tail; rotation would favor mixed conditions.
The final cash-session hours can reflect de-risking ahead of Nvidia. WATCH is conditional on persistent index-level direction rather than isolated stock moves.
Power-hour conditions may be more sensitive to Nvidia positioning. Tail would rise only if index structure turns one-way with weak retracements and broad confirmation.
The cash close can concentrate event positioning. Tail remains conditional on whether NQ carries a persistent directional structure into the after-hours window.
Nvidia is expected to announce results at approximately 20:20 UTC. The event raises Stress; Tail depends on the actual NQ reaction, retracement quality and semiconductor breadth after publication.
Nvidia's conference call is scheduled for 21:00 UTC. A multi-stage repricing is possible, but persistent Tail risk would require observed continuation through commentary and Q&A.
After the call begins, future structure remains unknown. Tail would stay elevated only if directional extension persists without meaningful retracement as liquidity thins.
Late after-hours risk should ease if the earnings reaction becomes two-way and volatility decays. Continued one-way extension would keep the conditional Tail path higher.
Into the next UTC day, Tail is expected to normalize if Nvidia-related price discovery is orderly. Any unresolved one-way second leg would invalidate that normalization.
